title: Sightless
description: !!! A horror mod that adds your new friend !!!
body:
There are events in the game that occur every 5 to 6 minutes. When exploring the world, be careful, as you may encounter an owner who does not like your presence. They will try to drive you away by making you crazy. To counter this, you have pills that should not be stored far away, as they can cause you to become paranoid and lose your sanity.
To trigger events, you can send a command to the chat:

```
/sightless_event <id> 0-10
```
To see your level of sanity, write to the chat:


```
/Sanity
```
